referees.quote: While the physics presented in the study is interesting and I enjoyed reading it, I find it rather difficult to recommend its publication in Nature Communications
I therefore recommend that the paper should be accepted to Nature Communications after considering the comments below.
I think it should be published in Nature Communications. I still have suggestions for improvements, which I would like to be addressed before the paper is accepted.

note: The file states the manuscript was previously reviewed at another journal; only Nature Communications versions are included, so Version 0 here is treated as the first round. R1 is inferred as reject because R1 judges the work incremental relative to Sci. Rep. 2022 and Bolle et al. 1999, and also raises technical and citation points. R2's first-round report was only an attached file ('See attached file'), so R2's wording is taken from the passages quoted in the authors' rebuttal. R2's requests are clarifications, explanations and figure fixes, hence minor revision. R3 asks for an expanded discussion of Fig. 3 but recommends publication, hence minor revision. R4 appears only in Version 1, as an early-career co-reviewer of one of the listed reviewers' reports; the file does not say which one. R4 therefore has no separate first-round report and cannot be assigned a recommendation, so R4 is omitted from the list.
